about_the_game:
Thanks, She's A Rescue is a straightforward First Person Indie Horror Game featuring a true first person avatar and an A.I that chases you around the map. Collect items, pick up and set down objects, Sneak passed the streamer while he's live and attempt to take the dog. If it catches you, it's over.

Story

You just heard that a popular streamer has been mistreating his dog for a while now and you're not gonna let him forget it. Sneak into his house, rescue the dog, and make your great escape. She will be much happier with her new master. :)

Features

True First Person RPG indie Horror Experience

A.I. chases you on sight and if he catches you, its bad

Locked Doors and Safes carrying secrets

Sneak passed the streamer while he's live, He turns around periodically 

Thanks, She's a Rescue is still being updated

This story is a work of FICTION. Any resemblance to actual persons, places, animals or organizations are purely coincidental and are not meant to harm the reputation of any person or company.
